name: explainer-spec
title: Explainer Spec
description: The plain-data description of an explainer film (scenes of a title, a chart, a map, a 3D model, a then-and-now comparison, a quote or a caption, each with a length, a transition, captions, a narration cue and a provenance label) and a validator that lists every fault in words.

meta.when: An assistant or a project writes a film as JSON and hands it to motion/explainer. Run validateExplainer first and show its faults: each says where the fault is and how to mend it. For a film drawn by hand from React, use film-stage directly.
